---
title: "Differentially expressed protein analysis"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
# Load library
library(DEP)
library(dplyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(SummarizedExperiment) 
library(readr)
```


```{r}
# 1. Female reproductive tract DEP
data <- read.csv("~/PMR/GWX workreport/GWX workreport/pepline/2.differential_expression_analysis/02.DEP/001.inputfiles_and_code/proteinGroups_FRT_LFQ.csv") 

a <- c(paste("LFQ.intensity.FRT_12h_",c(1:3),sep = ""),paste("LFQ.intensity.FRT_6h_",c(1:3),sep = ""),paste("LFQ.intensity.FRT_virgin_",c(1:3),sep = ""))

data_unique <- make_unique(data, "Majority.protein.IDs", "Protein.IDs", delim = ";")

# ===========generate SummarizedExperiment object==========
LFQ_columns <- grep("LFQ.", colnames(data_unique)) # get LFQ column numbers

experiment_design<-data.frame(condition=c(rep("PM12h",3),rep("PM6h",3),rep("virgin",3)),label=a,replicate=c(rep(c(1:3),3)))

data_se <- make_se(data_unique,LFQ_columns,experiment_design)

LFQ_columns <- grep("LFQ.",colnames(data_unique)) 
data_se_parsed <- make_se_parse(data_unique,LFQ_columns)

# ===========filter missing value==========
plot_frequency(data_se)
# At least one less protein in a group (e.g., in a group of three, two of which were identified as the protein) was identified.
data_filter <- filter_missval(data_se,thr = 1) 
plot_numbers(data_filter) 
plot_coverage(data_filter)
# ===========Normalization==========
data_norm <- normalize_vsn(data_filter)
plot_normalization(data_filter,data_norm)
# ===========Missing value imputation==========
plot_missval(data_filter)
plot_detect(data_filter)
# option1：The number of missing values is estimated by randomly sampling from a Gaussian distribution centered at the minimum.
data_imp <- impute(data_norm,fun = "MinProb",q = 0.01)
# option2：Missing data are estimated by randomly sampling from a manually defined left-shift Gaussian distribution.
data_imp_man <- impute(data_norm,fun = "man",shift = 1.8,scale = 0.3)
# option3：Use the k-nearest neighbor method to impute missing values.
data_imp_knn <- impute(data_norm,fun = "knn",rowmax = 0.9)
data_imp_MinProb <- impute(data_norm,fun = "MinProb",q = 0.01)
proteins_MNAR <- get_df_long(data_norm) %>%
  group_by(name, condition) %>%
  summarize(NAs = all(is.na(intensity))) %>% 
  filter(NAs) %>% 
  pull(name) %>% 
  unique()
MNAR <- names(data_norm) %in% proteins_MNAR
mixed_imputation <- impute(
  data_norm, 
  fun = "mixed",
  randna = !MNAR, # we have to define MAR which is the opposite of MNAR
  mar = "MLE", # imputation function for MAR #""MLE","knn"
  mnar = "min") # imputation function for MNAR #"zero

DE_analysis <- function(se) {
  se %>% 
    test_diff(., type = "all") %>%
    add_rejections(., alpha = 0.05, lfc = log2(1.5)) %>% 
    get_results()
}
DE_MinProb_results<-DE_analysis(data_imp_MinProb)
DE_imp_results<-DE_analysis(data_imp)
DE_knn_results<-DE_analysis(data_imp_knn)
DE_man_results<-DE_analysis(data_imp_man)
DE_mixed_results<-DE_analysis(mixed_imputation)
DE_prots <- function(results) {
  data_frame(Dataset = gsub("_results", "", results),
             significant_proteins = get(results) %>% 
               filter(significant) %>% 
               nrow())
}

objects <- c("DE_knn_results",
             "DE_man_results",
             "DE_mixed_results",
             "DE_imp_results")

data_diff_all_contrasts <- test_diff(data_imp_man, type = "all")
dep <- add_rejections(data_diff_all_contrasts,alpha = 0.05,lfc = log2(1.5))
# ===========Visualization==========
# PCA analysis
plot_pca(dep,x = 1,y = 2,n = 3000,point_size = 4)
plot_cor(dep,significant = TRUE,lower = -1,upper = 1,pal = "Reds")
# Heatmap
plot_heatmap(dep,type = "centered",kmeans = TRUE,k = 6,col_limit = 4,
             show_row_names = FALSE,indicate = c("condition","replicate"))
# Use contrast (i.e., direct sample comparison) as columns to create a heatmap
# Create a heatmap of all important proteins (rows) and test contrast (columns).
plot_heatmap(dep,type = "contrast",kmeans = TRUE,k = 6,col_limit = 10,show_row_names = FALSE)
# Volcano plot
plot_volcano(dep,contrast = "PM12h_vs_virgin",label_size = 2,add_names = TRUE)
plot_volcano(dep,contrast = "PM6h_vs_virgin",label_size = 2,add_names = TRUE)
# ===========results==========
data_results <- get_results(dep)
# The p.val and p.adj columns contain the original and adjusted p-values, respectively; the ratio column is the average log2 FC.
# The significant column indicates whether the protein is defined as significant/enriched according to the selected cutoff.
# The centered column contains the average log2 FC based on protein-wise centering.

# check number of DEPs
data_results %>% filter(significant) %>% nrow()

# Convert the SummarizedExperiment object to a data.frame
df_wide <- get_df_wide(dep)
df_long <- get_df_long(dep)

#It can save the final data object (dep) as well as intermediate objects of analysis, namely the initial SummarizedExperiment object (data_se), normalized data (data_norm), imputed data (data_imp), and differential expression analysis data (data_diff) for later analysis.
#save(data_se, data_norm, data_imp, data_diff, dep, file = "data.RData")
#write.table(data_results,"FRT_DEP_result.csv",row.names=FALSE,col.names=TRUE,sep=",")
```
